summary: Full retail regression for Vanalume. Backend: 20/20 pytest passing (products, config, orders shipping tiers, variant pricing, unknown-product 400, dormant Razorpay, admin auth, inquiries, newsletter). Frontend: Shop page renders 7 categories + 22 product cards with correct MRP/SP prices, category filter scrolls, pillar variant selector swaps image, Add-to-Cart opens drawer, same-product re-add increments qty, different variant creates new line, cart persists across reload (localStorage vanalume_cart_v2), navbar cart badge updates live, checkout empty-submit shows per-field 'Required', invalid email shows 'Valid email required', successful POST /api/orders shows Thank-you view and empties cart. B2B regressions (Contact, About founder modal, Home hero) still intact.
critical_code_review_comments: CartDrawer requires city + pincode as 'Required' on the frontend, while backend Customer model marks them Optional. Consistent — frontend stricter, fine.
CartContext shipping recomputed inline (subtotal>=2000 free) matches backend compute_shipping — good parity.
server.py compute_amount raises 400 for unknown / enquire-only products; response includes payment_configured=false and razorpay_order_id=null while Razorpay is dormant — matches spec.

Product images and prices in /app/backend/catalog.py match every SKU listed in the spec (Duet 1499/1899, Individual 599/999, Ensemble tin 999/1299, Ensemble metallic 1999/2599, Odyssey 1799/2299, Pillar 4/5/6 in 599/699/799, Pack of 3 1699/2299, Taper set 799/999, Wax set 599/799, Aroma stone jar 1299/1799, Sculpture 4999/5999, Oil set 999/1299).
Old backend_test.py referenced deprecated schema (price/stone-ceramic-pot); rewritten to current retail schema — regression file now stable.
test_credentials: ADMIN_KEY read from /app/backend/.env at runtime (not logged).
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_ (inquiries, newsletter, orders) persisted to Mongo; not cleaned up but scoped by prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest-xdist compatible, 20 tests, ~2s). Frontend testids in use: shop-page, product-<id>, add-<id>, filter-<catId>, cart-drawer, nav-cart-btn, nav-cart-count. Razorpay remains dormant; do NOT touch. Cart persistence key: vanalume_cart_v2. Aroma sculpture at 4999 could hit free-shipping threshold single-item — verified via ensemble-metallic (1999) instead. If Razorpay keys are supplied later, add tests around /api/orders/verify happy path.
